verdict.rationale: The README lists Winget, a standard Windows package manager, among its install options. It also offers Docker images and pre-built release binaries as quick alternatives to building from source. However, the Winget support appears only as a bare heading with no detail, and no other package managers for macOS or Linux are evidenced. missing for 10: package-manager install instructions/commands, cross-platform package manager coverage (e.g., macOS/Linux), independent hands-on corroboration of package-manager installation
